stories.title: Houthi ballistic missiles kill at least 53 at a Yemeni government military camp in Shabwa
stories.reason: Three missiles hit the al-Alam camp during a recruit training drill, wounding roughly 200 more, as Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said the camp was targeted for hosting Saudi personnel and the Presidential Leadership Council's Rashad al-Alimi vowed retaliation.

stories.title: France imposes curfews in Paris, Lyon and Lille after the worst protest violence in years over the cost of living
stories.reason: At least two people died and more than 2,000 were arrested as masked rioters looted Paris shops and torched Lyon's tourist office, prompting PM Sébastien Lecornu to not rule out declaring a state of emergency after the interior minister said police had 'lost control.'

stories.title: Australian MP Helen Haines loses a leg in the car attack outside her office; arrested man reportedly an anti-logging activist
stories.reason: The new details on Haines's injuries and the suspect's possible motive deepen Monday's attack, which PM Albanese called deliberate and which has drawn in Australia's national counterterrorism team.

stories.title: The UN's World Food Programme cuts Gaza food aid by about a third, leaving 500,000 people without support
stories.reason: Monthly recipients fall from 1.6 million to 1.1 million and rations are halved as WFP's Carl Skau says the cuts are purely a funding problem, with the agency needing $450 million over six months to sustain operations through winter.

stories.title: Trump says he's open to meeting Putin and Xi in China and that 'somebody else' should negotiate for Ukraine
stories.reason: The proposed trilateral summit, reportedly floated by Putin, would focus on nuclear arms rather than Ukraine, drawing objections from Kyiv's foreign minister who warned the format would only encourage Putin to keep fighting.

stories.title: AI chipmaker Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion at a $6.2 billion valuation to challenge Nvidia
stories.reason: The Series E, led by newly formed Trace Capital alongside Innovation X, more than doubles the 10-year-old startup's valuation and will fund volume manufacturing and international expansion for its open-weight AI and CPU chip designs.

stories.title: Inception Labs launches Mercury 3, a diffusion language model it says beats GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at 1,000+ tokens per second
stories.reason: The model is more than 40 times the size of the original Mercury and runs 4-8x faster than comparable rivals with a 1-million-token context window, though analysts at Artificial Analysis have questioned whether its benchmark comparisons are apples-to-apples.

stories.title: Haiti indefinitely postpones its December 13 elections as gang violence overwhelms voter registration
stories.reason: Only 769,000 voters had registered since July amid gang-blocked registration areas, and the UN's top Haiti official warned against setting a new date without first testing feasibility, as the Security Council heard 1,123 people were killed in gang violence since July.
